statement: Set up a geolocated building project from site context in minutes and create several building options on it.

source.ref: Geolocated project setup in Building Design

acceptance.corpus: project origin to WGS84 and back; closed-form ellipsoid conversion

statement: Develop building massing options with editable footprint, height, orientation and rotation, and keep several options in one project.

acceptance.corpus: extruded polygons; volume, GFA closed form

statement: Define levels with floor-to-floor heights, typical floor repetition and basement levels, and report area per level.

acceptance.corpus: stack of floors with varying heights; level elevations and areas by hand

statement: Edit facades with window patterns, balconies and panels per elevation, driven by ratios or explicit rules.

acceptance.corpus: glazing ratio per facade equals requested ratio within grid rounding

statement: Lay out floors with units, rooms, cores and corridors inside the massing, and see area totals update.

source.ref: Floor plan, unit and room layout

acceptance.corpus: rooms tile a floor plate; sum of room areas plus circulation equals plate area (invariant)

statement: Place cores, stairs and corridors with simple egress sanity checks (travel distance and width).

acceptance.corpus: travel distance on grid graph vs closed-form Manhattan on empty plan

notes: Egress checks in Forma are unverified; row sets a Dino minimum. key=bd_core_circ

statement: Produce building content at about LOD 200 (walls, floors, windows, doors, simple structure) that is semantically typed.

acceptance.corpus: exported model: every element has IFC class and quantities (schema check)

notes: Public sources say Autodesk targets LOD 200. key=bd_lod200

statement: Run analyses at building scale (daylight in rooms, sun on units, energy and carbon) on the Building Design model.

acceptance.corpus: CIE overcast daylight factor closed form for side-lit rectangular room (split-flux method)

notes: Which analyses exist in Building Design is partly unverified. key=bd_building_analyses

statement: Hand a Building Design model to Revit as a geolocated native model: walls, windows, floors and doors become real Revit elements, with site context.
superiority: Bidirectional exchange instead of one-way handoff.

acceptance.corpus: export IFC4 for element classes and counts; counts match source model

notes: Dino target is open IFC and native-format bridge; owner reference dataset from licensed Revit comes from the harness. key=bd_revit_handoff

statement: Keep desktop and cloud models connected so scenarios authored in the cloud open in the desktop client and updates flow both ways.

acceptance.corpus: two clients edit disjoint elements; merged state equals union (property test)

notes: Digest: Revit 2027 first Connected Client (tech preview); one-directional handoff is a listed complaint. key=bd_connected_client

statement: Produce area and unit schedules from the Building Design model and export them as tables.
Suggest room elements and layout completions with AI (autocomplete of rooms and fixtures) from partial input.

acceptance.corpus: suggestions always fit the room polygon and clearances (invariant over 500 samples)

notes: Described in the digest as an announced AI capability; maturity unverified. key=bd_autocomplete

statement: Bring in existing models (IFC, SketchUp, Rhino, Revit links) as design elements or context in a proposal.

acceptance.corpus: buildingSMART sample IFC and glTF Khronos sample models; counts and bounding boxes preserved

statement: Compare building options on area, carbon and analysis metrics in one view.
